name: Ichijou Maya
source:
A beautiful girl who has loved anime since she was a child. She entered a voice actor training school because she admired Yukari Katou, a charismatic voice actress who starred in primetime shows at the time.

She was shocked to learn that Yukari had already retired, but in order to make up for her lost time, she pleaded with the agency to have Yukari manage her.

Yukari is a single-minded and healthy girl. She has a character of not being able to say no when asked to do so. She is a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/injyokustudio/index.html]official site[/url]]
